name: SMA
derivation: Closes 1.00, 2.00, 2.00 sum to 5.00 and 5/3 does not terminate. Decimal division carries the default 28 significant digits, so the value is 1.666666666666666666666666667 - rounded at the last digit, not truncated. This vector exists so a future change to the decimal context or to a float implementation fails loudly instead of shifting every average slightly.
